## Interactive Experiences

- [Earth Playground](https://luiskr.com/earth-playground): 3D photorealistic Earth WebGPU simulation engine with atmospheric scattering, dynamic lighting, real-time post-processing and interactive sci-fi controls (available in all languages: `/earth-playground` and localized slugs like `/br/playground-da-terra`). The engine's own 2×-resolution captures form a rotating social-share set — every screenshot under `public/_v3/experiments/earth-playground/share/` on the CDN is enumerated per page (og:image rotation, `image:image` sitemap tags, an `ImageObject` ItemList in JSON-LD, and a parked gallery section in the emitted HTML) and through the machine manifest at [/meta/earth-playground-share.json](https://luiskr.com/meta/earth-playground-share.json); localized earth-image search themes link the captures to this portfolio in all 16 languages. The full control surface (every slider/checkbox's param, range and default) plus the engine start state ship in the page's static markup, a `WebApplication` JSON-LD entity, and the route's `.md`/`.json` replicas (`content.controls` / `content.engineDefaults`).
- [Star Field](https://luiskr.com/star-field-experiment): three.js cosmic-navigation experiment — a simulated galaxy of 100k+ catalogued stars plus 134 authored bodies (solar system, exoplanet systems, deep-sky objects) with localized dossiers. Deep-link any body via `/star-field-experiment/<body-id>` (e.g. `/star-field-experiment/mars`); localized slugs like `/br/experimento-campo-estelar` also resolve. The index page lists every body (ItemList + `DataCatalog`/`Dataset` JSON-LD), and the whole 139,563-record registry is fetchable as JSON — see the data endpoints below. Engine screenshots under the CDN `experiments/star-field/share/` prefix form the route's rotating social-share card set (random capture per fetch via `/meta/star-field-share.json`) and are image-indexed in every locale through sitemap `image:image` tags, a JSON-LD `ImageObject` ItemList and the page's parked share-gallery figures.
- [Animations Reference](https://luiskr.com/animations): every animation on the site, described — element, motion, trigger, technology and purpose — as static readable markup (no JavaScript required). Localized slugs like `/br/animacoes` resolve; the same records drive runtime `aria-label`/`longdesc`/`aria-describedby` on the animated elements themselves.

## Documentation Portal

- [In-depth project docs](https://luiskr.com/docs): English-only browsable portal — architecture docs, quality reports, test coverage and the annotated source trees of every module. Every manifest file is a crawlable `/docs/<root>/<path>` route with JSON-LD (`TechArticle`/`CollectionPage` + `BreadcrumbList`) and in-DOM microdata.
- [Docs: Documentation root](https://luiskr.com/docs/docs): architecture, build, CMS and data-model guides, plus the repository story (`/docs/docs/modules.md`).
- [Docs: Quality reports](https://luiskr.com/docs/reports): lint, security and coverage gate outputs.
- [Docs: Test coverage](https://luiskr.com/docs/coverage): per-file istanbul HTML reports (plus `coverage-<module>` roots per package).
- [Docs: Source code](https://luiskr.com/docs/src): the published application source tree (copy-protected in the viewer). Additional source roots publish each module: `shared`, `core`, `website`, `cms`, `earth`, `starfield`, `docs-exp`, `desktop` and `local-modules` (vendored deps).

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [API catalog](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset — service-desc/service-doc/status relations.
- [OpenAPI description](https://luiskr.com/openapi.json): spec for the read-only endpoints (docs-content JSON, catalogs, sitemaps).
- [auth.md](https://luiskr.com/auth.md): authentication guidance — public endpoints require no credentials.
- [OAuth authorization-server metadata](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server) and [protected-resource metadata](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 8414/9728 — the site's protected surface (CMS) authenticates via Google sign-in on Firebase Auth.
- [A2A agent card](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent-to-agent discovery card.
- [Agent skills index](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): sha256-pinned SKILL.md files under `/meta/skills/`.
- [MCP server card](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): SEP-1649 card describing the read-only resource surface.
- [Message-signatures directory](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory): Web Bot Auth JWKS for request-signature verification.
- Usage preferences: `Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes` on every response (and stamped into deployed `robots.txt` files); `Link` response headers advertise these resources on every page.

## Experiment Data Endpoints (`/experiments/`)

The canvas-rendered experiments ship their complete datasets as static JSON/binary so agents can read every object without executing WebGL:

- [Star-field registry manifest](https://luiskr.com/experiments/star-field/data/index/manifest.json): 139,563 catalogued objects — `{total, shardSize, kinds: {star, exoplanet, dso: {count, shards[]}}}`. Sources: HYG Star Database (119,626 stars), NASA Exoplanet Archive (5,974 planets), OpenNGC (13,963 deep-sky objects).
- Registry shards: `/experiments/star-field/data/index/<kind>-NNN.json` — 1,000-record JSON arrays (`star-000`…`star-119`, `exoplanet-000`…`exoplanet-005`, `dso-000`…`dso-013`); abbreviated fields documented on the index page and in the replica's `content.deepCatalog`.
- [Packed binary](https://luiskr.com/experiments/star-field/data/deep-field.bin): the same catalog as float32-LE records (x,y,z ly, magnitude, B-V, kind) behind a uint32 count header.
- Body dossier JSONs: `/experiments/star-field/data/<locale>/<body-id>.json` — the raw localized dossier (facts, history, credited NASA imagery/audio) behind each `/star-field-experiment/<body-id>` page.
- [Earth Playground replica](https://luiskr.com/earth-playground.json): `content.controls` (group/label/param/type/range/shipped+effective defaults) and `content.engineDefaults` (the engine's GUI-constants start state) — also mirrored in `/earth-playground.md` and every locale twin.
- Share-capture manifests: [`/meta/earth-playground-share.json`](https://luiskr.com/meta/earth-playground-share.json) and [`/meta/star-field-share.json`](https://luiskr.com/meta/star-field-share.json) — `{generated, prefix, count, images[], files[]}` listings of each experiment's social-share screenshot set. The runtime draws one image at random into the `og:image`/`twitter:image`/`itemprop` card metas on every page fetch; the full sets are indexed via sitemap image tags, JSON-LD `ImageObject` ItemLists and per-page gallery figures in all 16 languages.

## Full-Content Replicas (`/llm/`)

Every public route ships a build-time **Markdown replica** and **JSON replica** containing the page's complete localized content and every media asset — ~19,000 routes × 2 formats × 16 languages, generated from the site's Firebase data.

- [Replica index (JSON)](https://luiskr.com/llm/index.json): machine-readable catalog — per-locale route lists, conventions, policy.
- [Replica index (Markdown)](https://luiskr.com/llm/index.md): human/agent-readable entry point.
- Per-locale route lists: `/llm/<locale>/routes.json` (en, br, es, de, hrk, cas, riv, gn, it, ru, fr, tln, nl, ca, gl, ga).
- **Canonical tree**: `/llm/<locale>/<route>.md` and `/llm/<locale>/<route>.json` — English routes live under `/llm/en/` (`/` → `/llm/en/index.md`), docs are English-only.
- **Sibling convention**: append `.md` or `.json` to any page URL — `https://luiskr.com/portfolio/metcha.md`, `https://luiskr.com/br/lgpd.json`, `https://luiskr.com/star-field-experiment/mars.md`.
- Coverage: home, about, contact, legal, animations, both playgrounds, all 13 project pages, all ~520 localized media deep links, all 144 star-field body dossiers, and the entire `/docs/` portal (5,900+ files) — in every locale where the route exists.
- Each page advertises its replicas with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` + `<link rel="alternate" type="application/json">` in `<head>`.
